asymptotic_threshold.scope: Lx=Lz=L, Ly=2, L->infinity; IID depolarizing code-capacity noise
asymptotic_threshold.explanation: The gauge group is that of a (2L)x(2L) Bacon-Shor code under a qubit permutation. At every fixed p>0 the depolarizing gauge-coset distribution approaches uniform as L grows, so optimal block LER approaches 3/4. Finite-size crossings are crossovers, not a positive asymptotic threshold.

threshold_report.numerical_interval_meaning: Bisection brackets, not statistical confidence intervals.
threshold_report.crossing_source: Exact model rates; Monte Carlo estimates are plotted separately.
threshold_report.crossing_limit: Only crossings bracketed by the supplied p grid are detected.
